_comment: Reference copy of the GLOBAL Claude Code hooks this toolkit owns.
Claude Code does NOT read this file. It is the written-down record of what
~/.claude/settings.json is supposed to contain, so the configuration is
recoverable and reviewable instead of living only on one disk.
Only SessionStart lives here. PreToolUse and Stop are declared in
skill/SKILL.md's frontmatter, which is already version-controlled and travels
with the skill. SessionStart cannot go there: a skill loads mid-session, so a
SessionStart hook declared in it would never fire.
The command is deliberately tolerant. The doctor lives in a git repo whose
branch can change, and a SessionStart hook that errors would greet every
